nom: Lancôme Tonique Confort Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Toner

avis.titre: Not the same as the original definitely not better
avis.texte: I saw reviews that it was different but decided to see for my self and the reviews were right. I have stopped buying so many products because the new and improved is always worst.product leaves skin very dry original did not

I know the formula has changed, I have been usng Lancome for many years but this one somehow makes my skin look glowing. I keep hear people say my skin look so nice lately. Ever since I started using this toner! So its become my favorite.

Well, I see all the reviews wanting the old formula back… I didnt get to try the old formula but for me this one was very hydrating and the smell is lovely. I also love that its thick and not watery because you're not wasting product.
This used to be my favorite and now it is unusable. Bring back the original!

I saw this and thought I would give it a try. I'm impressed! I use it in the morning after cleansing like I would use an essence. My skin looks great after using it a month so this toner is a win for me.

avis.titre: Used to be worth the price
avis.texte: I got this toner after trying it in stores a year ago and loved it. I iust ran out and I notifed the packaging was different so i tried it again. Unfortunatly my skin did not respond like it normally does and this is after using the previous bottle last night.

I was hesitant to buy this toner due to the reviews. But boy am i glad i ventured out. This toner has been a game changer in my skin care routine, it has helped my texture, provided moisture, and my face feels amazingly soft after I use it. I absolutely love this product. 12/10. I've been using it only for over a week and can tell a huge difference. It was the last piece I needed in my skincare.

They changed the packaging and with it the formula. Since I have been 18 years old this has been my holy grail skincare/personal care product. It is no longer worth the price and I am quite disappointed with the change. 10 years and time to find a new toner.

I have been buying this toner for years and absolutely loved how it made my face feel. This new formula is sticky, has a strange smell and felt like it dried my skin almost immediately after using. I am so heart broken. If I had known they were changing the formula, I would have stocked up. Sadly wont be purchasing it anymore.
This product is wonderful, it makes your skin feel hydrated. Be sure and to shake really well before using.

So disappointed! The packaging is different. The salesclerk said the formula wasn't changed. She was wrong. It is now the same as any witch hazel astringent and dried out my face. Price is still the same but no longer a silky toner. Will not be buying again. And was a buyer of this for many years.

avis.titre: The old one is more better
avis.texte: This Toner was 10/10 it really help with dry skin but also took off the dirt ! This New Formula is not hydrating and burns skin and leaves face tight i very disappointed! Yall need original one back asap !

avis.titre: They changed the formula (NOT WORTH THE MONEY)
avis.texte: I have been using Lancôme for the past 6 years. I noticed immediately that this is not the product I have known throughout the years. It smells different, the texture is a bit sticky and has a liquid soap feel on my face and skin. I decided to compare the ingredients from my other bottle and sure enough, the formula is completely different. I will never buy this product again unless they go back to its original ingredients. Not worth the money. I am highly disappointed is Lancome. I will be making changes with my other Lancome products if they do this with any of them. Great product gone BAD
I have used Lancome products for 50 years, and have always been pleased with them.

this product seems very overpriced for what it is. despite being advertised as 'great for sensitive skin', It is VERY fragranced (floral) and that's never great for skincare. there are definitely cheaper/better options out there.

I've been using this toner for over a decade and they didn't just changed the packaging but also the formula. No more almond oil or rosa damasco. The color and texture is way different and it burned my skin. I only wore it once. I compared ingredients and textures its sad that an amazing product gets changed so drastically for non good reason.

I've purchased this product before and I loved it. I still do but I'm not sure if it's the same as the previous one that I got, It seems the bottle was changed. A little goes a long way and it seems like it's going to last a while too, I don't know if I'll repurchase or just find more affordable products.

avis.titre: Hands down my fave toner of all time!
avis.texte: First & forever toner I'll be buying! Super hydrating on the skin perfect for applying after cleanser. Love mixing it in with my Lancôme foundation best combo for a more hydrating and smooth base while doing my makeup. Not sticky at all!

I started using this twice a day about a year ago. My skin is noticeably smoother and fresher. I am 68 years old. Several people have asked me what I'm doing differently to my facial skin. I've never used a toner that felt this good when you put it on. I'm sold!
